method:
Elo over every UFC fight since 2010, in date order.
  expected  E = 1 / (1 + 10^((Rb - Ra) / 400))
  update    K x (S - E), K = K_BASE x (1 + NEW_BOOST / (1 + fights before)) so debut fighters move fast.
  debut     not a flat 1500: seeded from the pre-UFC pro record, 1500 + 100 x (ln(1+W) - ln(1+L)) - 150
            (ESPN career record minus the UFC results we have, so a 14-0 prospect starts well above a 6-4 one).
  age       in each matchup a fighter loses 20 rating points per year past 30 (birthdates from ESPN); the
            published rating is age-free, the win probabilities are not.
  Draws count 0.5; no-contests are skipped. Ratings regress RUST of the way toward 1500 per year idle.
